Mosi (triceratops.glb) — model source and rights note
=====================================================

Model: generated by the game owner with Tripo AI (Tripo3D, https://www.tripo3d.ai) from the owner's own
concept images. The input images are not part of the release.

Rights: the owner generated this model on a paid Tripo plan (confirmed 2026-10-15). Tripo's help pages say
that paid-plan users may use, modify, distribute and commercially exploit the models they generate:
https://www.tripo3d.ai/help/privacy-policy/how-to-use-tripo-models-commercially
Keep a copy of the Tripo terms in force when the game is published.

Changes made for the game (Stjörnufar project, lab/gfx-demo/tools/bake-mosi.mjs):
- the unrigged 11-part Tripo export was rotated head-first and scaled to the previous Mosi footprint;
- the parts were merged into one skinned mesh on an 18-bone skeleton that keeps the old bone names and rest
  orientations (Body, Shoulders, Neck, Head, Tail1-Tail5, four legs and four feet), with soft skin weights;
- new idle and walk clips were authored;
- textures were reduced from 2048 to 1024 pixels (JPEG) and the metal/roughness map was removed.

Mosi á íslensku: eigandi leiksins bjó líkanið til í Tripo AI á greiddri áskrift, sem gefur viðskiptarétt
samkvæmt Tripo. Geymið afrit af skilmálum Tripo þegar leikurinn er gefinn út.
